_doc: The queued next experiment for the volcanic arena (ledger: game/docs/research/retunes/volcanic.md). GRADE ONLY: this is a grade_preview.py grade JSON; apply it to volcanicGrade() in game/src/render/hd2d/arenas/volcanic.ts and touch nothing else (key SpotLight stays #ff9a52 70, hemisphere/top fill stay, SpriteLight stays). Preview it first: python3 -I scripts/grade_preview.py <accepted>/raw/volcanic-desk.clean.png --from assets/retunes/volcanic-cur.json --to assets/retunes/volcanic-next.json --out <scratch>/pv --layout <accepted>/capture.json:volcanic-desk --arena volcanic --sheet, then verdict_risk.py pv.json pv_to.json --arena volcanic --change grade (and the same on the phone frame).

unchanged.spriteLight: baseline (keyColor #ffa060 x0.66, sky #9a8070 x0.55, rim #ffb46a x0.95)

expected_outcome: desk: floors pass, no `worse`, queued for the owner (family grade_strength); phone: likely `worse` or no_difference because the portrait floor gradient is only 6 L* and any gamma lift flattens it; report it and hand the phone to orbkin-render-look as its own change (tier-specific grade or an apron light source), never fix the desk and assume the phone (rule 8).
why_not_the_pilot_variants: every captured variant A-J and the environment-only Fenv cut the key (70 -> 40..55) and/or desaturated it; critique.py --arena volcanic shows near_bstar 0.31-0.72x the accepted frame on every one of them, verdict_risk predicts `worse` for all, and the three that were judged (H, J, Fenv) lost 0/4 twice each. Keep the key.
budget: 1 desk + 1 phone capture (~4 + 2 min at load < 10), craft_check + verdict_risk (seconds), 2 judge calls ($0.45, ~2 min), owner kit.
